about: Register a UAE national's trip abroad with MOFA so the ministry can reach them in an emergency.
note: Requirements read from the official MOFA service page on the checked date. MOFA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Twajudi registration for UAE travellers. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

channels: MOFA website or UAE MOFA app, sign in with UAE PASS
